title: Separate issuer-specific fiat flows, collateral hierarchy, agent-service payments and repository verification state

decisions.rule: Record concentration even when identity is undisclosed. Do not attribute the counterparty to Circle, Ripple or any named entity without filing-level evidence.
Circle Mint fiat conversions are issuer-primary-market flows, not total USDC supply changes, exchange flows or XRP capital flows.
Separate fund assets, bank cash, access-denied liabilities and FDIC coverage. Do not label USDC holder liabilities as FDIC insured.

Keep recognized lending, recognized derivatives and unrecognized customer collateral separate. Absence of XRP from a token-level table is not proof of zero XRP exposure where aggregate unrecognized collateral lacks token breakdown.
Separate service payments from XRPL ledger transactions. Batch Checks can settle many service payments; aggregate multi-asset counts are not native-XRP demand.
Separate investment, partner-list participation, MOU, intended integration, closed beta and production deployment. Do not infer XRP settlement from a multi-rail partner list.
Treat stolen XRP as a custody event and potential future supply overhang. Do not classify it as sell pressure until on-chain disposition or executed selling is observed.

Scheduled analysis may generate artifacts but must not write to main without explicit approval. PR branch verification is distinct from deployment/activation; 30-day artifacts are not the durable feature store.

feature_admission: NONE. Coinbase concentration, Circle Mint flows/reserves, T54 service payments and Binance incident observations remain context-only until point-in-time synchronized history and out-of-sample predictive value are demonstrated.
